keyPhrases.text: It's good to have a new musical to watch in this awful year
the first five minutes...kick-started my cold heart
unbeautiful but glossy surface grows increasingly depressing
The Prom lacks much of the original's spirit
I will admit I've been annoyed since Murphy announced his cast

reasoning: Mixed review with qualified praise and significant reservations. Acknowledges positive elements (music, choreography, good to have new content) but criticizes the adaptation's lack of spirit and depressing surface. Shows disappointment rather than enthusiasm.
